_comment: Vast.ai search profile for gsplat training via 3dgs-cloud-worker. SHA-pinned (same pattern as lichtfeld.json). WARNING: image is CUDA 12.1 / Torch 2.1.2+cu121, arch list 75;80;86;89;90 — Ampere/Ada/Hopper only. Do NOT land Blackwell cards (RTX PRO 4000/5000/6000, compute_cap 1200/SM_120): their kernels will not load. min_compute_cap 750 alone does not exclude Blackwell, so the launcher must reject compute_cap >= 1000 until a CUDA 12.8 base (v0.2.0) ships.
